titles.romaji: Rick and Morty: Summer Meets God
titles.native: リック・アンド・モーティ サマー・ミーツ・ゴッド

description: Summer’s new boyfriend isn’t human, Jerry’s in big trouble as usual, and Rick is well… just being Rick. Don’t miss the new Rick and Morty short, Summer meets God from Takashi Sano acclaimed director of the Tower of God series.
